hooks.prompt:
After editing any file in autoload/claude-multi-status.el, IMMEDIATELY run the syntax validation tests using: ./test/run-syntax-tests.sh

This is CRITICAL to catch parenthesis mismatches before they cause module loading failures.

If tests fail:
1. Show the user the full error output
2. Identify which function has the syntax error
3. Fix the error immediately
4. Re-run the tests to verify the fix
